blind_to: model labels (natural_labeled.csv not opened), all embeddings and results
conventions: noun-modifier or material use with no individual X referred to -> X (LABELING.md v2)
modifier that refers to a particular instance (the river landscape of the Limmat) -> O
simile or counterfactual comparison containing the target -> A-idiom (test 2: inside a figure)
verb uses, other senses (chair = person, bridge = card game or music, fork = bifurcation or motorcycle part), company/brand names -> X
plural particulars on an occasion -> O; habitual or repeated events -> A-gen

revisions.method: candidates from a spaCy parse (target modifying a following noun) plus the two material uses; each checked against the rule from the sentence alone
revisions.disclosure: applied after the first κ check; about 25 of Qwen's v1 labels had been seen in the disagreement printout. No other gold label was changed.
